name: Lin Wenqi
intro: I build shaders, VFX and real-time systems that turn motion and material data into clear visual feedback.
about: I’m a Computer Science undergraduate working across shaders, real-time VFX and interaction systems in Unity. I focus on how authored data, runtime logic and rendering work together to make technical behavior legible.
